description: Study main window on Android: the bundled static export talks to the backend over HTTPS and keeps notes in IndexedDB, so the shell exposes only the core runtime, the app version and the fullscreen/focus window controls that exist on mobile, plus the `shell_info` build-identity command, `update_feed` (reads the release feed; the bucket has no CORS) `youtube_captions` (YouTube caption fetch from the device — the backend's IP is blocked by YouTube), the sign-in link that opened the app (`deep-link:default`), reminders scheduled on the device (`notification:default`) and opening https pages in the system browser (Google sign-in).
